title: Preserve authored tempo and sound automation details
scope: Retain interpolation, text and visibility on authored tempo/sound events while separating sync-point occurrence fields.
acceptance: Test linear and step events with the same non-default value and distinct text/visibility at one position.
Keep event order and public edit authority explicit; validate positions and finite values.
GP8/AlphaTab retains each representable detail; source-only details have precise diagnostics rather than broad normalization.
exclusions: SyncPointData.barOccurence is a sync-point field, not a generic Automation field.
Bank events are handled by midi-bank.
